notes.title: New Update (1.0.2)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello drifters![/b][/h1] 

We just released a new update!


[h1][b]Change Log:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Detailed City map (Gas Stations, Parkings, Shops, manholes, trash)
[*]Updated MiniMap!
[*]Removed street lighters for more comfort!
[*]Fixed wall bugs & grass walls!
[*]Fixed non-sync players position/rotation!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995647/feffe9d46eb25c47008c2d8148142c0ac480fc89.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995647/9e753abd1c8f84a39af0b637ea2d6273465c8867.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995647/43e38a57d3c300257431cdbc92c20524150375d6.png[/img]

[h1][b]Coming next:[/b][/h1] 
[list]
[*]Advanced Engine Modifications (Dissemble/Assemble with a lot of parts available)!
[*]Advanced Engine Tuning - 
Tune Rev Limit (Max RPM, Soft Cut, Hard Cut)!
Tune Boost (Max PSI/Bar)!
Tune AFR/Fuel Injection (AFR, Fuel Flow, Fuel Pressure)!
Tune Spark Timing (Retard degree)
[*]And more interesting things to do!
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995647/d32f09cc93a3751c3a566499bbcc907da457d530.png[/img]

Stay tuned for next update, Share with your friends who loves cars tuning, drift and just having fun! This game will be your dream game if you want! Just help us to improve it every day, leave your ideas, comments, thoughts!

Happy drifting to everyone!
